units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 32:41">Targ. Deut. XXXII, 41</cite> (Y. II <cite ref="B01317"><he>בְּרָקָא</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:7">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ יחידאה</he> a single flash (for vers. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="B01325"><he>בְּרָקִין</he></cite>, <he>בַּרְקִין</he>, <cite ref="B01329"><he>בַּרְקַיָּא</he></cite>, <he>בַּרְקֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:15">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 15</cite>; a. fr. [Y. R. Hash. II, beg. <he>ברק ברקא</he>, read <cite ref="B01320"><he>בַּרְקַאי</he></cite>.] Ber. l. c. <he>וברקיא ירוקתא</he> some ed. (read <he>ירוקרקי</he> as Ms. M.). Ib. <he>דבריק ברקי ומנהמי וכ׳</he> (read <he>דברוק</he>, v. also Rabb. D. S. a. l.) the lightnings break through and make the clouds rumble &c.

Bekh. 38ᵇ וסימנך ברקא and thy sign (by which to remember which of the two affections of the eye is considered a blemish) take barka (meaning white and cataract, and like the cataract is the floating white spot in the eye a disqualifying blemish). V. next w.
